R00.title: Enterprise Account Executive
R00.description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.
Enterprise Account Executive

Parallel Systems is seeking a commercially driven, hands-on sales leader to own revenue generation and customer expansion across freight railroads, intermodal operators, and logistics partners. This is not a transactional sales role. You will operate at the intersection of freight economics, operations, and technology, positioning Parallel’s autonomous rail system to unlock new revenue, improve lane performance, and modernize how railroads compete with trucking.

You will act as a trusted commercial partner to customers, combining sales execution with a deep understanding of freight flows, lane economics, and customer value creation. This role is ideal for someone who has sold complex freight or logistics solutions, understands how shippers and brokers think about lanes, pricing, and service levels, and can translate that knowledge into durable rail partnerships.

You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, operations, and executive leadership to ensure commercial strategy, customer commitments, and deployments are aligned and scalable.

Responsibilities:

Own end-to-end sales execution across a defined universe of freight rail, intermodal, and logistics customers, from prospecting through close and expansion.

Lead customer discovery focused on freight lanes, shipper needs, service reliability, and revenue opportunities enabled by Parallel’s system.

Position Parallel’s vehicle and software platform as a revenue and network optimization solution, not just a technology deployment.

Develop commercial proposals, pilot structures, pricing models, and long-term agreements tied to customer ROI and lane performance.

Build strong relationships with customer commercial, operations, and executive teams to drive internal alignment and deal momentum.

Translate market and customer insights into go-to-market strategy, sales messaging, and product priorities.

Create repeatable sales playbooks for outbound strategy, deal qualification, pipeline management, and post-sale expansion.

Represent Parallel at industry events, customer meetings, and strategic forums with credibility across both commercial and operational audiences.

Partner with legal, regulatory, and policy teams to ensure commercial structures align with rail and transportation requirements.

What Success Looks Like:

After 30 days: You understand Parallel’s system, target customer segments, and freight use cases well enough to engage credibly in commercial conversations and advance early-stage deals.

After 60 days: You independently run customer engagements end to end, including deal strategy, internal alignment, customer follow-ups, and executive-level discussions.

After 90 days: You are actively running outbound and inbound sales campaigns across your target accounts, building pipeline, advancing opportunities, and managing early customer relationships. Ideally, you have closed an initial deal and built a healthy pipeline across multiple stages, with clear line of sight to future revenue growth and expansion.

Basic Requirements:

3+ years in sales, business development, or customer-facing commercial roles selling complex technology platforms. 

Demonstrated experience selling complex B2B solutions tied to disruptive technology.

Ability and desire to operate as a high-impact individual contributor with ownership of revenue outcomes.

Experience working in startups, new business lines, or early-stage commercial environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

Background in freight brokerage, third-party logistics, or shipper-facing sales.

Strong understanding of how shippers, brokers, and carriers evaluate service, cost, and reliability.

Comfort engaging deeply on lane economics, network design, and operational tradeoffs.

Strong systems thinking with the ability to connect customer pain points to scalable commercial solutions.

Clear, confident communication style that builds trust across operational, commercial, and executive stakeholders.

Compensation:

The expected salary for this role is between $180,000-$200,000 plus commission/incentive pay, with an on-target expectation of $300,000-$500,000. 

We are committed to providing fair and transparent compensation in accordance with applicable laws. Salary ranges are listed below and reflect the expected range for new hires in this role, based on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, and location. Final compensation may vary and will be determined during the interview process. The target hiring range for this position is listed below.

$150,000—$200,000 USD

R02.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Seattle, USA
R02.description:
SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling.

As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.

This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title.
Role and Responsibilities

Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.

Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity.

Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer.

Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders.

Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.

Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.

Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.

Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.

Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.

Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.

Travel within the assigned territory as required. 

Required Skills and Experience

5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.

Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.

Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners.

Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.

Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software.

Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills.

Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences.

Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills.

B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field.

Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred.

About KIPP NYC:

Founded in 1995, KIPP NYC Public Schools is a non-profit network of 18 free, public charter schools located in the Bronx, Brooklyn, and Manhattan. We partner with families and communities to create joyful, academically excellent schools where every child grows up free to create the future they want for themselves and their communities.
From our first middle school, KIPP Academy in the Bronx, to today’s network of eight elementary schools, nine middle schools, and one high school, KIPP NYC provides students with engaging academics, arts, athletics, and social–emotional learning that prepare them for college, career, and beyond.
Our commitment doesn’t end at graduation. Through KIPP Forward, we continue to support our alumni as they navigate college, career, and life, helping them define success on their own terms and pursue the paths that align with their goals and sense of purpose.
Together, we serve more than 9,400 students, support 4700 alumni, and employ over 1,100 dedicated team members who bring passion, expertise, and commitment to our mission every day.
About KIPP NYC Culinary:
Since 2016, the KIPP NYC Culinary Team has been reimagining what school food can be by providing students with fresh, scratch-cooked, nutritious, and delicious meals at no cost to students or families. As an extension of KIPP NYC's commitment to creating joyful, academically excellent schools, the Culinary Team plays a vital role in ensuring students have access to healthy meals that support their learning, well-being, and overall success.
Today, the Culinary Team serves nearly 10,000 students across 18 KIPP NYC schools and continues to expand its innovative scratch-cooking model. In Fall 2026, the team will complete its expansion across the network, bringing high-quality school meals to every KIPP NYC student.
In recognition of its impact and bold vision for the future, KIPP NYC was awarded a Regional School Food Infrastructure Grant by the New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets. This transformational investment will support the development of the KIPP NYC Culinary Institute—a central production and teaching kitchen, commissary, and workforce development hub that will strengthen school meal operations, expand career pathways for students, and deepen partnerships with local communities and New York State food producers.

Position Overview:
The Dishwasher is an important member of KIPP NYC's Culinary Team, helping to ensure the kitchen operates safely, efficiently, and in compliance with all food safety and sanitation standards.
Reporting to the Head Chef, this role supports daily meal service by maintaining a clean and organized kitchen, washing dishes and equipment, assisting with food preparation, and contributing to a positive team environment. While previous commercial kitchen experience is preferred, we welcome candidates who are eager to learn, take pride in their work, and are committed to supporting students through high-quality food service.
This role requires a dependable, hardworking individual who values teamwork, maintains high standards of cleanliness and safety, and helps create an environment where students can enjoy healthy, delicious meals every day.
This is a full-time, in-person position requiring on-site work five days per week. The role is based at one of our KIPP NYC campuses across the Bronx, Brooklyn, or Manhattan. Your primary work location will be determined by your leadership team.
Duties and Responsibilities:
General responsibilities include (but are not limited to):
Kitchen Operations
Wash and sanitize pots, pans, dishes, utensils, trays, serving equipment, and kitchen tools throughout meal service.
Assist with bussing trays, bins, and dish return stations during breakfast and lunch service.
Maintain a clean, organized, and sanitary kitchen, dishwashing area, and servery.
Support food preparation activities as directed by the Head Chef or culinary staff.
Assist with meal service, kitchen setup, and cleanup as needed.
Support special meal functions, events, and additional food service activities.
Food Safety & Sanitation
Follow all Department of Health (DOH), USDA, HACCP, and KIPP NYC food safety, sanitation, and cleaning procedures.
Maintain assigned workstations in a clean, organized, and sanitary condition.
Properly clean, store, and care for kitchen equipment and supplies.
Maintain acceptable standards of personal hygiene and adhere to department dress code requirements.
Immediately report equipment issues or safety concerns to the Head Chef.
Team Support
Work collaboratively with the culinary team to ensure efficient kitchen operations and high-quality meal service.
Assist in other areas of food production or service based on operational needs.
Demonstrate reliability, professionalism, and a commitment to outstanding customer service.
Maintain regular and dependable attendance.
Working Conditions
Regular exposure to temperature variations, moisture, steam, and wet working conditions.
Frequent standing, walking, bending, reaching, lifting, and repetitive hand motions.
Ability to lift and move supplies, equipment, and food items weighing up to 50 pounds.
Exposure to heat from ovens, steam tables, dishwashing equipment, and kitchen appliances.
Exposure to moderate to high noise levels during meal service.
Required to wear appropriate personal protective equipment and follow all kitchen safety procedures.

High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
Previous experience working in a commercial kitchen, school nutrition program, restaurant, or food service environment preferred, but not required.
Fundamental understanding of food safety, sanitation, and cleanliness practices, or willingness to learn.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment while maintaining high standards of quality and customer service.
Strong interpersonal skills that contribute to a collaborative, respectful, and positive team environment.
Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, students, and school staff.
Self-motivated with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently while supporting team goals.
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions with strong attention to detail.
Ability to perform the physical requirements of the role, including standing for extended periods; carrying, bending, stretching, stooping, pushing, pulling, and lifting items weighing up to 50 pounds.
Demonstrates professionalism by modeling KIPP NYC's core values of zest, grit, hope, love, social intelligence, gratitude, and a sense of humor in all interactions with students, families, colleagues, and community members.
Demonstrates a commitment to continuous learning, professional growth, and continuous improvement by actively seeking and applying constructive feedback.
Deep commitment to KIPP NYC's mission and belief that every student deserves access to healthy, high-quality meals that support joyful, academically excellent schools.

Compensation & Benefits:
KIPP NYC offers an hourly rate of $17.00 – $19.00. Hourly ranges at KIPP NYC are standardized by role level and function, and individual rates are determined with an equity lens, taking into account years of relevant experience.
KIPP NYC offers a generous benefits package, including, but not limited to, the following:
Robust benefits include medical, dental, and vision. 
Generous time off, including 5 school vacation weeks, sick and personal days, and an extended summer break. 
Up to 12 weeks of 100% parental leave. 
Bright Horizon Back-up Child and Elder Care.
Employer-paid Life Insurance and Short-term/Long-term disability.
Employee incentives include an 8-week paid Sabbatical after 10 years, annual professional development funds, and tuition reimbursement.
This description is intended to describe the type of work being performed by a person assigned to this position. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities required by the employee.
This role is based in NYC and will require travel to our schools. If you relocate outside of a commutable distance or out of the state of NY, your employment will be subject to review, which may include separation from KIPP NYC. You must notify HR if you move or have plans to relocate.

KIPP NYC LLC is committed to creating a welcoming environment that includes employees with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We believe that enables us to better meet our mission and values while serving students and families throughout New York City.

Identify and develop expansion opportunities grounded in demonstrated customer value 

Represent customer reality to platform and leadership with enough credibility that it changes decisions.

Product judgment in the field: translates customer reality into product direction, not just feature requests; can say no credibly and explain why.

Technical translation: bridges the gap between customer engineering teams and Scale platform engineers; does not relay messages, adds interpretation.

Operating in ambiguity: creates structure where there is none; makes decisions with incomplete information; does not wait for fully defined requirements.

Scale has been the leading AI data foundry, helping fuel the most exciting advancements in AI, including frontier model training, enterprise adoption, defense applications, and autonomous vehicles. Our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions.

The next frontier for AI is the physical world. We're looking for an AI Product Manager to own the Robotics vertical within our Physical AI team. In this role, you'll own both the development of the data and training environments (the teleoperated demonstrations, real-world collections, simulated tasks, and annotation products that labs use to train and evaluate robot policies) and the "data as a product" strategy that powers them. You'll understand where physical AI is headed, decide what robot tasks and embodiments are worth collecting, how to source and structure the underlying data, and how to turn deep domain knowledge into a defensible product.

The ideal candidate has lived inside robotics or physical AI research, and is able to pair that domain understanding with a sense for where current robot policies succeed and fail in real-world workflows.

A strong entrepreneurial & go-to-market mindset will be necessary.

8 years of PM experience and 3 years of experience in robotics or physical AI in one or more of: robot learning or manipulation research, teleoperation and data collection systems, robotics software or hardware engineering, or a robotics product role, with real depth in how the work gets done.

A builder's mindset: excited by ambiguity and motivated to create new products from the ground up.

Product or customer-facing experience: A track record of owning outcomes, shaping roadmaps, or working closely with technical stakeholders (formal PM experience is a plus but not required if domain depth is strong).

Operational rigor: Comfort going deep with Ops on quality and throughput, and reasoning about unit economics across hardware, labor, and annotation cost.

Bias for action: Comfort wearing multiple hats and operating in fast-moving environments.

A degree in Robotics or a related quantitative field (Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, etc.).

Ph.D. in Robotics or a related quantitative field, OR a Master's degree with 3+ years of equivalent professional experience in an applied research setting.

About the Role

Together AI is building the AI Native Cloud, an end-to-end platform for the full generative AI lifecycle, combining the fastest LLM inference engine with state-of-the-art GPU cloud infrastructure. The Together Cloud team builds the [Together GPU Clusters](https://www.together.ai/gpu-clusters) flagship IaaS product that provides high-performance, AI-ready GPU clusters through a self-serve cloud console, along with the virtualized infrastructure layer powering Together's inference, RL, and fine-tuning products.

As a Senior Software Engineer focusing on AI Compute in the Together Cloud org, you will build and own major components of the next generation AI cloud platform – a highly available, global cloud infrastructure with cutting-edge virtualization of the latest ML hardware: GB300s/VRs, BlueField DPUs, InfiniBand and dual/quad-plane RoCEv2 fabrics. That virtualized computing platform powers our own SaaS products – inference, RL, and fine-tuning – and serves external cloud customers through self-serve offerings such as on-demand/reserved Kubernetes/Slurm clusters, across dozens of data centers and hundreds of thousands of GPUs.

The hard problems in rapidly scaling heterogeneous GPU fleets are software problems: fully automated bootstrapping of GPU data centers, high-performance virtualization of GPU compute and DC networking without compromising isolation or portability, and fault-tolerant decentralized control planes. We solve them by building global and in-DC services, Kubernetes operators, and high-performance SDN libraries, forking hypervisors and Linux kernels, and building infra tailored to inference and fine-tuning. You'll own massive greenfield projects across their full lifecycle – scoping the problem and writing PRDs with our PMs, designing the system, and building it through to GA launch.
Responsibilities

Build the GPU and network virtualization stack: the hypervisor, kernel, and SDN work that makes GPU compute and DC networking high-performance, portable, and strongly isolated across heterogeneous hardware.

Build and maintain our in-DC IaaS layer: the services, Kubernetes operators, and libraries that provision and manage compute, storage, and networks in our data centers, including VMs, parallel filesystems, VPCs, and InfiniBand partitions. Implement and harden the bring-up path for a new Vera Rubin data center with thousands of GPUs.

Scale the distributed GPU scheduling and global management plane: the control-plane services behind on-demand and reserved clusters, including the automation that onboards new capacity and raises per-cluster limits.

Harden the monitoring and automated remediation layer for fault tolerance: automated detection, isolation, and recovery of failed nodes that keeps distributed pretraining and large-scale inference fault-tolerant.

Own your components end-to-end: write the design docs, break the work into milestones that ship incrementally, and improve the reliability of what's already in production.

Raise the bar around you: code review, design feedback, and mentoring junior engineers.

Build the tooling other teams rely on: testing frameworks, developer tools, and documentation that make our systems robust and usable across teams, plus contributions to the core, open-source Together AI platform.

To be successful, you'll need to be deeply technical, ready to own projects truly end-to-end, and an excellent communicator — strong software development fundamentals, strong systems knowledge and troubleshooting instincts, and the collaboration and diplomacy skills to work across teams.
Requirements

5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language (Golang desired).

R55.description:

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team

Link helps Stripe's merchants deliver frictionless and secure checkout experiences by auto-filling customers' payment information, letting customers check out in seconds and pay in one click across the Link merchant network. The Link Bank Connections team is responsible for the connectivity layer to financial institutions that enables Financial Connections to offer users seamless, reliable, and performant access to financial data.
What you'll do

We’re hiring a Staff Software Engineer to lead the design and delivery of new money-movement capabilities in Link. You will take ambiguous product opportunities and turn them into reliable, scalable, and intuitive experiences for consumers and merchants.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with broad technical and organizational scope. You will own large, cross-functional projects from early product and technical definition through launch and iteration; lead teams of engineers through complex execution; and partner closely with the many Stripe systems and teams that make money movement possible.

You will work across the stack, building services and APIs as well as the user experiences that expose those capabilities. The work may involve modern financial infrastructure—including stablecoin-enabled capabilities—while requiring sound judgment around safety, reliability, compliance, and user trust. You will make the architectural decisions that let the balance model scale globally, and raise the engineering bar for the team as we grow.
Responsibilities

Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and execution for large, ambiguous Link initiatives that create new money-movement primitives.

Own projects end to end: clarify the problem, define an incremental technical plan, align stakeholders, drive delivery, launch safely, and use results to guide further investment.

Build robust, scalable backend services and high-quality consumer-facing experiences across Java, Ruby, and TypeScript.

Lead a project team of engineers through execution, creating clarity on priorities, decisions, risks, and delivery milestones.

Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Risk, Infrastructure, and other Stripe teams to build capabilities that are safe, reliable, and useful.

Navigate dependencies across Stripe’s payments and money-movement platforms, making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, user experience, operational reliability, and durable technical foundations.

Raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, design reviews, mentoring, and constructive feedback across the team.

Help shape the team’s longer-term roadmap by identifying opportunities, technical risks, and investments needed to scale Link’s financial capabilities globally.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

10+ years of backend and/or full-stack software development experience, with a track record of owning large, ambiguous systems end-to-end.

Demonstrated technical experience leading the design and delivery of large, complex software projects from early definition through production launch.

Strong full-stack engineering skills, including experience building reliable backend services and polished user-facing product experiences.

Experience leading and unblocking a group of engineers on a substantial project as a senior individual contributor.

Ability to operate effectively in high-ambiguity environments: framing problems, making durable technical decisions, and creating an actionable path forward.

Excellent cross-functional and cross-organizational collaboration skills, with the ability to align teams with different systems, priorities, and constraints.

Strong engineering judgment around system reliability, operational excellence, security, and maintainability.

A product-minded approach to engineering, with a focus on delivering meaningful outcomes for users and the business.

Preferred qualifications

Experience with Java, Ruby, and/or TypeScript. We care more about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn than expertise in a particular language or framework.

Experience building payments, money-movement, fintech, or other regulated financial products.

Experience building consumer products at scale, particularly products that require a high degree of user trust.

Experience working on 0→1 products or taking new capabilities from concept through launch and iteration.

Familiarity with stablecoins, digital assets, or the infrastructure that enables global financial products.

Appreciation for the importance of good documentation—internal and external—and taking pride in seeing projects through to successful completion

K-8 Staff: 7:30am - 4:30pm, K-8 Students: 8:00am - 3:30pm, Wednesday K-8 student dismissal is at 1:30pm 

High School Staff: 6:45am - 3:45pm, High School Students: 7:15am - 2:30pm, Wednesday High School student dismissal is at 12:30pm.

Why Teach at KIPP? 
At KIPP, we see the gifts in everyone who walks through the doors of our schools - especially our teachers. Their skill. Energy, Love. Their determination. On the good days and on the hard days. So we support our teachers to make the most of those gifts.
The KIPP Difference 

Respect - For our teachers’ innate talent and desire to learn, for their professional growth, and for the lives they lead beyond our walls. We offer pay and benefits that reflect our appreciation for the invaluable role our teachers play in lighting paths to opportunity for students

Support - As our teachers progress through the day, the year, and their careers, we ensure they always feel the KIPP Team and Family at their backs, with opportunities to lead and support to grow

Purpose - Together, our students, schools, families and communities share an ambitious mission to create a future without limits. We need talented teachers to realize it. Shape the future for your students and yourself by joining us in our work. 

KIPP Jacksonville Public Schools is seeking full-time, salaried Sr. Guest Educators who are passionate about education and working toward becoming fully certified teachers in Florida.
This is an excellent opportunity for aspiring teachers and experienced educators who are actively working toward their Florida teaching certification and want to be in the classroom while completing their certification requirements.
The Sr. Guest Educator role may be a great fit for educators who are:
Working toward obtaining a Florida Department of Education (FLDOE) teaching certificate
Holding a certification with a subject-area, ESOL, or Reading flag that they are actively working to clear
Completing coursework, certification assessments, or other requirements needed for their professional certificate
Looking for a way to continue teaching and gaining classroom experience while completing their certification pathway
Sr. Guest Educators are expected to carry out the responsibilities of a classroom teacher, including:
Serve as the classroom teacher for an assigned grade level and/or subject area
Prepare and deliver high-quality, standards-aligned instruction
Maintain high expectations for student achievement, engagement, and behavior
Establish a positive, structured, and inclusive classroom environment
Assess student learning and adjust instruction to meet student needs
Collaborate with teachers, school leaders, and support staff
Communicate effectively with the school team to ensure consistency and a smooth experience for students
Carry out all responsibilities expected of a full-time classroom teacher
Once you obtain your Florida teaching certification or Statement of Eligibility (SOE) from FLDOE, you will be eligible for promotion to a Lead Teacher position.
This role provides a unique opportunity to teach, grow, and make an impact now while working toward your long-term career as a certified Lead Teacher at KIPP Jacksonville Public Schools.

403b retirement program with a company match***
Professional development

Bachelor's Degree
Clear path to obtaining a Florida Teaching Certificate
Demonstrate ability to work collaboratively with a team of teachers

R67.description:
About KIPP New Jersey
KIPP New Jersey is part of the nationally recognized “Knowledge Is Power Program” network of free, open-enrollment, college-preparatory public schools dedicated to preparing students for success in college and in life. In 2002, KIPP New Jersey first opened its doors in Newark’s South Ward as a single class of 80 fifth graders and has since grown to educate 7,035 students in grades K-12 across 15 schools in Newark and Camden. More than 90% of KIPP New Jersey students currently qualify for free or reduced meals. 
By 2025, KIPP New Jersey will have fifteen schools in Newark and five in Camden providing a world-class education to over 10,300 students. To learn more, visit www.kippnj.org.

Here’s what you need to know:   

Our high school is seeking awe-inspiring teachers to guide our students as they climb the mountain to college and beyond. Our teachers are dynamic leaders both in and outside of their classroom. They love students, working with families and the community they serve. 

High School Spanish Teacher 

We are seeking experts in the following content areas:
Spanish
Here’s what you’ll be doing:

Joining our schools as a teacher comes with the opportunity for significant growth and development, but with great power comes great responsibility.  Your role as a teacher will include a number of responsibilities which will include but are not limited to: 
Create, internalize, modify and prepare lesson plans in accordance with academic curriculum, working closely with the grade-level team.
Use data to responsively teach to mastery of academic skills. 
Work closely with students, families and colleagues to create an environment that is supportive of student progress.
Reinforce a firm foundation for all classes and uphold classroom management techniques.
Help with diagnostic and progress monitoring testing across the school
Monitor student progress and adjust teaching strategies to ensure all students meet the learning objectives.
Update student performance trackers and use data to help guide your lesson plans.
Participate in school, departmental and parent meetings 
Participate in school events, activities and programs both during and outside of regular class instruction hours.

Must Haves
A belief in every student’s limitless potential. 
A Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university (Official transcripts showing degree conferred are required prior to the starting date of employment).
A minimum cumulative GPA of at least 3.0 if graduation date is after 2016 or minimum cumulative GPA of 2.75 if degree conferred before 2016.
Appropriate state teaching certification completed and issued or in process of being completed. 
Subject matter expertise.
A minimum of two years of teaching experience, with demonstrated interest in working with students from diverse economic and cultural backgrounds.
A track record of success in the classroom.
A collaborative attitude towards teaching and learning.
Nice to Haves: 
A record of exceptional student achievement and results at a high-performing charter network/charter management organization. 
A belief that all students deserve a world class education which can be achieved through education reform.

Compensation & Benefits
In addition to a competitive salary, KIPP NJ offers a full comprehensive benefits plan, including health care, retirement, a school laptop, and transportation benefits for TEAMmates commuting into New Jersey from the Philadelphia area. 
KIPP NJ offers competitive salaries to newly hired lead teachers. Salaries are based on prior experience and in accordance with certification requirements. KIPP NJ offers a competitive salary range of $63,000-$101,000+ for teacher positions with additional opportunities for earning up to $5,500 annually in performance-based pay.
